newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to cut June wholesale prices.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to cut June wholesale prices.

text.p: Leading refiner Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would slash its wholesale price for gasoline, gas oil and kerosene by 0.9 yen per litre effective June 1.
The cut will bring the wholesale price for gasoline down to 89.6 yen per litre and that for gas oil to 67.9 yen per litre, both including tax.
The price of kerosene, which is not taxed at the wholesale stage, will be set at 35.8 yen per litre, Nippon Oil said.
The cut reflects lower prices for April-lifting crude oil, which offset the extra cost from a weaker yen against the dollar, Nippon Oil said in a statement.

Major Japanese refiners review their wholesale product prices on a monthly basis, and adjust them according to movements in global crude oil and petroleum product markets, as well as the currency market.
